identification: Group of three framed pen and watercolour Tasmanian house studies (Egmont Cottage Westbury, Entally House Hadspen, Perth), signed Cheyne Purdue, a minor Tasmanian topographic artist. Small reproduction-style tinted drawings in matching timber frames; likely multiples or prints with hand colouring, not unique works.

entries.note: Cheyne Purdue framed watercolour 'Cradle Mountain Glade' 75 x 49 cm, a larger single work. Paid locally (Armitage): what we might pay, NOT a resale price. Database record only.

viewing_check: Check whether the works are original pen and watercolour or printed with hand tinting (look for dot pattern or plate marks), confirm signature and any edition numbers, and check for foxing under the glass.
